# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure — Rosewood Street Bakery

**Report ID:** RSB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14, 2024
**Date of Report:** March 22, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team
**Classification:** Internal — Quality & Safety

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:20 p.m. on March 14, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Street Bakery experienced a compressor failure during a period of high ambient load. The failure went undetected until staff arrived at 4:15 a.m. the following morning. By that time, internal cooler temperatures had risen from a normal 38°F to 61°F, exceeding the 41°F food safety threshold for approximately six hours. All temperature-sensitive inventory — including custards, cream-filled pastries, mousse cakes, fresh dairy, and egg products — was discarded per company policy. Total loss was valued at $4,280. The bakery opened two hours late and operated with a reduced menu. No contaminated product reached customers, and no illness was reported.
